display_name: Soldatenarbeitszeitverordnung (Soldiers' Working Time Regulation), § 1 and Anlage, with Soldatengesetz § 30c and § 93(2): time off for soldiers' overtime, the exemption for international establishments, the power it rests on, and the citation requirement of Grundgesetz Art. 80(1) sentence 3
citation: Soldatenarbeitszeitverordnung vom 16. November 2015 (BGBl. I S. 1995), § 1 and Anlage as recast by Art. 5 No. 7 of the Verordnung vom 6. März 2025 (BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 78), in force 1 April 2025; Soldatengesetz §§ 30c, 30d, 93, as printed on gesetze-im-internet.de on 2026-11-02
authority: Federal Republic of Germany. SG § 93(2) no. 7 makes the Federal Ministry of Defence the maker of the regulations that disapply § 30c(1) to (3) and (5) under § 30c(6).

source.provider: gesetze-im-internet.de (Bundesamt für Justiz, run by juris GmbH); recht.bund.de (Bundesgesetzblatt)
source.note: Per-norm pages for SAZV § 1, its Anlage and Eingangsformel and SG §§ 30c, 30d, 93, converted to one line per paragraph; the gazette texts and PDFs of the 2025 and 2022 amending regulations; excerpts of BVerwG 3 B 51.18, BVerwG 2 C 31.15, OVG NRW 3 A 1217/14 and BVerfG 2 BvF 3/90. bgbl.de answered curl with a JavaScript shell; the 2022 gazette was read in a browser and the owner saved the PDF.

why_this_subject: Felix Ringe and Linus Folkerts, 'Legal exploits may emerge at scale' (28 October 2026), https://www.felixringe.com/legal-exploits/, Case 3: they argue that the 2025 listing of NATO's Joint Support and Enabling Command (JSEC) in the Anlage is void because the amending regulation's preamble does not cite SG § 30c(6) with § 93(2) no. 7, the power to exempt soldiers at multinational establishments, so a soldier posted there keeps the time off for overtime that § 30c(2) gives. The gazettes show the 2025 regulation recast the whole annex (41 rows in 2022, 88 in 2025) and that the 2022 regulation was made under § 93(2) nos. 6 and 7, neither of which the article mentions. This subject encodes the entitlement, the exemption, the power and the citation test, and answers the soldier's question under both readings. It does not decide which is right.
encodings_note: Two rows. legalese-sonnet-5.5 encodes SG § 30c(2), (4) and (6), SG § 93(2) no. 7 and SAZV § 1 with its Anlage only. legalese-opus-5.5 encodes SAZV §§ 5(2), 6(1) and 12(1) as amended by Art. 5 Nos. 1, 3 and 4 of the 2025 regulation, with the § 30c(5) sentence 1 no. 1 citation test. Neither encodes the rest of the Soldiers Act or the Regulation; read the display_name as the subject, not as a claim about coverage.
